project_info.theme: Soft aesthetic fashion portrait with a red rose
project_info.color_palette: pastel pink and lavender background, red rose, pale blue cap, denim blue, white, and silver

main_subject.detail: adult man with two-tone hair, black with blonde streaks, light stubble beard, calm direct expression, wearing a light-blue baseball cap with a small embroidered flower, denim jacket over a white shirt, and a silver chain necklace
main_subject.action: holding a red rose vertically so the flower covers one eye
main_subject.style: soft aesthetic male fashion portrait with natural skin texture and realistic facial detail

composition_elements.framing: vertical close-up portrait with the face and rose dominant in frame
composition_elements.subject_position: adult man centered slightly to the right, rose stem extending toward the lower foreground
composition_elements.background: minimal pastel studio background with generous negative space and no extra objects

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large diffused softbox at approximately 5000K with gentle frontal fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft natural highlights, delicate shadow modeling, shallow depth of field, dreamy quiet atmosphere

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with a 50mm portrait lens at approximately f/2, editorial fashion photography
technical_specs.finish: soft color treatment, visible natural skin texture, restrained saturation, subtle film grain and natural vignetting

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A soft aesthetic portrait of an adult man holding a red rose flower over one eye, wearing a light blue baseball cap with a small embroidered flower, two-tone hair black with blonde streaks, light stubble beard, denim jacket over a white shirt, and silver chain necklace. Use a minimal pastel background, soft natural lighting, shallow depth of field, editorial fashion photography, dreamy mood, high detail, a 50mm lens, and a soft color palette. Frame as a vertical close-up with the rose and face dominant, natural skin texture, restrained saturation, subtle grain, and realistic shadow detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted face, duplicate rose, text artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the adult person, accessory, and wardrobe references for identity and styling continuity; the pastel background is optional. Keep the rose-over-one-eye composition, cap flower, denim-and-white outfit, silver chain, and soft pastel mood consistent. The adult identity, exact pastel hue, and background are replaceable; if a face reference is supplied, preserve its facial structure and likeness without celebrity identity.
